title: DemoBoundary
description: The audience boundary of the HAR-129 demo (HAR-129 'Demo surface boundary', section D and 'FINAL DEMO SURFACES'): the only two audience surfaces, the one visible trigger (Play in the web control plane), the audience flow in product terms, and the terms that must never reach audience copy (developer tooling, terminal commands, proof plumbing, out-of-scope experiments). The instance is contracts/demo/boundary.v1.json; Go, TypeScript and the docs check read it, so the forbidden-term list lives in one non-Markdown file.

invariant.description: The boundary invariant, verbatim. Changing it needs an explicit HAR-129 contract change approved by the product owner.
invariant.const: Ghost demo audience surface = Web Control Plane + Cliff in Slack. Internal developer/admin/proof tooling must never be promoted into the audience-facing demo without an explicit HAR-129 contract change approved by the product owner.

audience_surfaces.description: Exactly the two audience surfaces HAR-129 names. Nothing else is a demo surface.

visible_trigger.description: The one visible trigger of the product flow: Play in the web control plane, which calls the real backend.

core_endpoint.description: The core route the web Play control calls (contracts/openapi/core.yaml). The web test asserts the Play action posts exactly this path.

audience_flow.description: What the audience sees, in order, in product terms. Every step is on one of the two audience surfaces; exactly one step is the trigger, and it comes before any Cliff step.

forbidden_terms.description: Regular expressions (RE2 and ECMAScript compatible) that must not match any audience copy: web user-visible strings, the eval wording table, Slack renderer copy and goldens, the audience flow and any 'Audience walkthrough' section of a demo doc.

internal_tooling.description: Tooling that may power the product but is never a demo surface, step or term.

trigger.description: True on the one step where the human presses the visible trigger.
